name: agent402-client
description: Agentic Finance (AIFI) buyer SDK: buyer-side SDK for Agent402.Tools (x402): resolve a task to a tool across a catalog of 500+ pay-per-call endpoints (400+ tools + 100+ skill packs) and call it with payment handled for you - free tools settle via built-in proof-of-work (no wallet), wallet-only tools via your x402 fetch - with a withNetworkPreference helper to pick the settlement chain (USDC on Base/Solana/Polygon/Arbitrum/Monad/Celo/Avalanche/Sei/Optimism/Stellar/Algorand or USDG on Robinhood Chain - 12 chains). Caching, idempotent retries, cross-seller Smart Order Router. Pays over x402 (@x402/fetch) or MPP (mppx: Base/Celo USDC or native Tempo) - hand it either payment-aware fetch.
